problems.issue: Missing meta description and page title tags in the document head.
problems.impact: Impairs search engine optimization (SEO) and click-through rates from search engine result pages (SERPs).

problems.issue: Utilization of older library versions (Bootstrap 4, jQuery 3.3.1, MDBootstrap 4.7.0).
problems.impact: Can lead to slower load times, potential security vulnerabilities, and outdated mobile rendering behaviors.

problems.issue: Inline CSS styling used extensively within the head element alongside multiple external stylesheet dependencies.
problems.impact: Increases page weight and render-blocking resources, negatively impacting Core Web Vitals and mobile performance.

opportunities: Implement structured data (Schema.org for MedicalBusiness/Dentist) to enhance local SEO and rich snippets in search results.
Upgrade to modern CSS frameworks or compile a single minified stylesheet to reduce render-blocking JavaScript and CSS.
Add explicit width and height attributes to the logo header image to prevent Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS).
audit.summary: The website for Novodental is functional with standard tracking implementations (GTM, FB Pixel), but lacks crucial on-page SEO meta elements and relies on slightly dated frontend frameworks. Optimizing resource delivery and adding structured data will improve search visibility and user experience.

outreach.subject: Quick thought on Novodental Robinsons Manila's site
outreach.body:
Hi there,

I was looking at the Novodental Robinsons Manila site and noticed it's missing page titles and meta descriptions in the head tags. Without these, it's tough for Google to properly index the pages and for patients to understand what you offer right in search results.

I also spotted a few older frontend frameworks running under the hood that might be slowing down mobile load times for patients browsing on their phones.

We put together a quick, live demo of the site with these fixes applied to speed things up and boost visibility. Would it be useful if I sent it over?

Best,
Rahul

---
If you'd prefer not to hear from me again, just reply 'unsubscribe' and I'll remove you right away.

[{"Name":"brandon","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjVsO80ZGm4kVgQhuPSc9CW03DfzxJ5Tus9O-Mh0MFR1uPpfU6oY=s120-c-rp-mo-ba12-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"I’ve never been a fan of going to the dentist, but this is one clinic I’ll gladly keep coming back to.

A few close friends recommended their family dentists, Dr. JJ and Dr. Bea, when I finally decided it was time to have all four of my wisdom teeth removed after months of pain.

From my very first consultation, I immediately felt at ease. Dr. JJ and Dr. Bea were warm, approachable, and took the time to explain the procedure thoroughly, which really helped calm my nerves and gave me the confidence to schedule the surgery.

On the day of the operation, they removed all four of my wisdom teeth in about 2–3 hours, and everything went incredibly smoothly. My recovery exceeded my expectations - I was feeling much better within two weeks and was back to eating normally.

I recently returned for a deep cleaning, and I have to mention that Dr. Bea has some of the gentlest hands I’ve ever experienced. The procedure was far more comfortable than I expected.

The entire team also deserves recognition. LJ and Janine were consistently friendly, welcoming, and accommodating throughout every visit. Even the massage chair in the waiting area was a thoughtful touch that helped ease my anxiety before my appointments.

If you’re someone who has always been afraid of the dentist like I was, I genuinely think you just haven’t found the right one yet.
